title: delivery.fact.departed_for_receiver v1 payload
description: ADR-0011 D4 — the driver has set off. Notification turns this into the three-way pre-delivery notice of v6.3 p.26: app notification, SMS and a phone call, giving an ETA rather than an exact time.

eta_window_minutes_from.description: An ETA window, never an exact time (v6.3 p.26).
